"So, you're still playing on the 'living' team, huh?  Glad to see you're still kicking around.  Always good to run into a familiar face nowadays."
dynamic_line.no: *glances your way, then makes eye contact as you move closer to speak.  He is a strong-looking man in his mid forties, his hair graying and his face flecked with stubble and travel dust.
